messages.text: I've never wanted a tattoo until I saw this.

My dad isn't physically dead, but he ran out on me when I was 8 and chose drugs. But for 8 years before that, he tried his best to get clean. My mom only ever remembers the day he left, but for me those 8 years are insanely precious.
5,556 hours or 231.5 days sober today. Yesterday was my birthday and it was the first sober one since I was 23. I just turned 35.
833 days today. My wife to be just shared this post with me. From Bristol, UK to Long Island. Sending love and prayers.
2,794 days in recovery myself. I've always had this lingering feeling of wanting to become a tattoo artist. This woke that up again.
I just lost a very close family member, the mother of my 10 year old niece. She struggled with addiction and depression but she lost the battle on Jan 5, 2026. Jen, your life matters.
Brought me to tears. I'm reading this on the way to the hospital to have my baby boy. Thank you.
